response.sql: WITH patient_labs AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) as avg_alb, AVG(CASE WHEN l.UN IS NOT NULL AND l.`T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND l.`T-BIL` != 0 THEN l.UN / l.`T-BIL` ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX != '' GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), sex_level AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) as sex_avg_alb, AVG(avg_ratio) as sex_avg_ratio FROM patient_labs GROUP BY SEX), mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg_alb) as overall_mean_alb FROM sex_level) SELECT s.SEX, s.sex_avg_alb, s.sex_avg_ratio, s.sex_avg_alb - m.overall_mean_alb as above_mean FROM sex_level s CROSS JOIN mean_calc m WHERE s.sex_avg_alb > m.overall_mean_alb ORDER BY s.SEX
